question: Does moving Kev-4B from a PyTorch fp32 backbone to a quantised llama.cpp one change the decision?

corpus.note: every case at every presentation ordering; orderingsFor(n, 4, 20260921)

machine: Metabox Edge, i7-1355U, 32 GB LPDDR5, Intel Iris Xe 96 EU (UMA), Vulkan offload -ngl 99
finding: All three backends score the same 47/56. Q8_0 reproduces the PyTorch decision on 56/56 records; Q4_K_M reaches the same accuracy by a different route, disagreeing on four, two in each direction. Q8_0 is the shipped default because it is decision-identical, not because it is more accurate. Accuracy is quoted against the floors above; without them the 47/56 is not interpretable.
